events.text: As of March 2025, Maynilad aims to increase its reliance on clean energy to 15% of total power requirements, with a target range of 35% to 50% by 2037.

Maynilad is targeting carbon neutrality by the end of 2027, with plans including additional solar panel systems, more use of electric vehicles, and purchase of electricity from renewable energy sources.
With its shift to 15-percent clean energy, Maynilad can reduce its CO2 emissions by nearly 18,000 tons per year, equivalent to 4,284 gas-fueled cars off the roads.
Maynilad has commissioned a 1-megawatt (MW) solar panel in its La Mesa treatment plant.
EastWest was named Blue Bond of the Year - Philippines at the 2025 ABF Corporate & Investment Banking Awards for Maynilad's inaugural Php 15.0 billion Blue Bond issuance.

Maynilad Water Services, Inc. received a copy of a DENR-PAB Order dated May 5, 2026 imposing a penalty of PHP 37.45434 million for violation of Republic Act No. 9275 (Philippine Clean Water Act of 2004) and its implementing rules and regulations.

On August 6, 2019, the Supreme Court En Banc took up G.R. No. 202897, a petition by Maynilad Water Services, Inc. against the Secretary of the Department of Environment and Natural Resources, the Pollution Adjudication Board, and EMB regional directors.
